name: Dark Ages 19 (story)
notes: Gravestones declared at level start on 3-2, 4-5, 5-1, 8-2, 9-3, 9-4 hold no plant while they stand; give ground for that activation once one has been destroyed. The level protects magnetshroom at 6-1, 6-3 and 6-5; the artifact skips a protected plant as a source, and its cell holds no other plant while it stands. Entering the level shuffles gravestone bags of 3, 6 and 3 objects with the shared engine, in that order, before anything is planted.
